description: List all available individual metrics (272 metrics across bitcoin, calculated, eth, macro categories). Includes the Fed balance sheet, M2 supply, Treasury yields, net liquidity, the dollar, cross-asset indices (SPY, QQQ, VXX, UUP) and Bitcoin price and hash rate. Optionally filter by category or search term. No authentication required. A free key reads the 17 metrics in the bitcoin category in full, and the latest reading of the other 255. A basic key reads 240 in full, and the latest reading of the 32 that only pro briefings use. The pro tier reads every metric in full.

category.description: Filter by metric category: bitcoin, calculated, eth, macro

search.description: Search term to filter metrics by name or description
